objective: Prevent blank-white Android Wall photo tiles caused by early native completion events and unreliable default Expo paint
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android production OTA 01a187da-74ba-760e-881c-98fbeba334f8, runtime 1.3.2, source be4808452711866dc57066844dfee111050c0318. On-device paint remains unverified by request; user provided fresh white-tile screenshots.
acceptanceChecks: Android starts with the independent native renderer and retains disk cache before URL signing
Only the current URL/current renderer can mark a tile painted; missing dimensions do not count as success
Native transfer with byte progress is never restarted; true 40s stalls can try Expo Image once
Preview sidecar, original viewer, manual retry and secure signed URLs remain intact
No HTML/web/iOS, database, storage authorization, authentication or native build changes
Static regression tests and TypeScript gate pass before any production release; OTA stays on runtime 1.3.2
